kicker: The SGit Newsroom · the year as stories
title: 2026, one story at a time
description: The SGit Newsroom's year: one site per month, one site per story that matters, each built from captured evidence. October 2026 is live with the PHP flaws; the other months are placeholders until a story opens them.
lead_html: The newsroom publishes articles and a daily wire. This site is the other axis: time. Each month has a site, each story that is big enough gets a site of its own, and every one of them is built the same way, from sources captured, dated and hashed into a vault, with a status word on every claim. Start at a month, go down to a story, and come back up the same way.

how_html: A hub site is one JSON file rendered by one script with no clock in it: the same data gives byte-identical pages. The gate checks links, twins, llms.txt, determinism and credential shapes before every release, and the release script refuses to call a release done until the live site serves the new version. The method is the one the story sites use, at the smallest size that still follows it.
